brief:
American rapper Macklemore opened his "Free Palestine" concert tour in Dublin on October 26, vowing to continue speaking against Israel's war in Gaza, according to Al-Monitor. The tour was organized after Macklemore was dropped as the opening act for Ed Sheeran's shows.

At the tour's opening, Macklemore pledged to fight "until my last breath" in his advocacy against the conflict in Gaza.
dek: By Padraic Halpin DUBLIN, Oct 26 (Reuters) - American rapper Macklemore vowed to continue to speak out loudly against Israel's war in Gaza at the opening of his "Free Palestine" concert tour organised after he was dropped as the opening act for Ed Sheeran…
title: Macklemore launches 'Free Palestine' tour after Ed Sheeran removal
